observations.conclusion: Version/digest/expiry/disclosed capability checks belong to the observation envelope; it is not a QuantOS RiskInputSnapshot or market source admission.
Protocol 1.0 permits one ReducePosition intent; request idempotency key is caller-created and scoped by the engine principal. No compatible QuantOS signed-command mapping.
Transport-neutral boxed future submit/receipt trait. No UDS/stdio implementation or venue authority is established by the trait.
Clear local findings do not grant production authority; engine can revalidate and reject every input.

Full rejects original Restricted. Redacted runs a caller-supplied redactor, validates its output, then rejects Restricted on the redacted output; it is not an unconditional original-Restricted deny. Any adoption requires explicit redactor trust/reclassification and storage review. None adopted.
Trace stores ObservationRef and caller policy metadata/outcome, not authoritative risk/approval/order/Fill or QuantOS exception closure.
Generated owner/stability/required/retention/digest metadata is a design reference; metadata does not confer runtime authorization.
